title: Flu hospitalization rate per 100,000

source.name: CDC FluSurv-NET cumulative hospitalization rates
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: The cumulative flu hospitalization rate for the 2024-2025 season was 127.1 per 100,000 people overall -- the highest since the 2010-2011 season -- and 598.8 per 100,000 for adults 75 and older.
